title: Create common i18n function for platform-wide full translation
description: Implement a shared i18n utility/function across the platform to provide a single API for full translations (docs, UI, tests). This should make it easy to translate strings, load locale bundles, and apply translations consistently across doc-site, entities, and other projects.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Expose a stable function `i18n.t(key, opts)` usable across platform modules
Support loading locale bundles from `data/locales/{locale}/` and fallback to canonical docs
Provide helper to pre-fill missing keys (machine-translate) with clear review markers
Backward-compatible API so doc-site and existing entities can migrate incrementally
Unit tests covering API and integration tests for doc loading with different locales
Add CI check to detect missing keys across locales and fail on unexpected literals in code/tests

subtasks.text: Design API surface for common i18n (t, init, loadBundle, listMissing)
Implement `entity/common/i18n.js` refactor to provide shared functions
Update doc-site and entity consumers to use new API (gradual migration)
Add `scripts/i18n-prefill.js` enhancements to call translation API and mark machine translations
Add CI workflow (i18n-check) to repo (if not already present) and enforce on PRs

notes: This task follows from doc-site i18n work; aim is platform-level consolidation and safer automation for translations.

history.note: Planned after doc-site language selector completion
